title: Comprehensive Downtown Parking Study & Management Plan
short_description: Consulting services for a downtown parking study and management plan in Shelton, Connecticut.
project_scope: Preparation of a comprehensive downtown parking study and management plan for the City of Shelton. The assignment covers multidisciplinary transportation planning, traffic engineering, and urban planning analysis related to parking supply, demand, operations, and management strategies. No building, bridge, or structural technical characteristics are stated.
services: Transportation planning, traffic engineering, urban planning consulting, parking study, management plan, traffic studies, planning/master planning, traffic design engineering, urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Pure transportation planning and parking management study with no structural or building design component.
- Falls under urban/open space planning and consulting rather than sbp's core structural engineering profile.
- No bridge, roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building scope indicated.
- No planning component for civil engineering structures or structural design phases.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is for a planning study and management plan only, with no defined construction scope or physical works from which a realistic construction cost estimate could be derived.
